name: Rhydolion
accommodation: Four 5-star self-catering properties (including Sgubor, Llofft Yr Yd and Hoewal longhouse) plus camping and caravan pitches
suitableFor: Couples, families and campers; Sgubor has a wet room and downstairs bedroom
beachAccess: Campsites.co.uk lists it as 0.6 miles from Hell's Mouth
confirmedFeatures: Self-catering cottages, camping and caravan pitches, wet room in Sgubor
overview: Rhydolion is at Llangian near Abersoch on the southern Llyn coast, around 0.6 miles from Hell's Mouth. It offers four self-catering properties, including a traditional Welsh longhouse, alongside camping and caravan pitches. Online booking is not available, so enquiries go direct by phone or email.
surfTripFit: It is the closest listed base to Hell's Mouth, giving quick access to the beach whether you camp or take a cottage.
